```yaml
name: Rule Type Param Changes Comment

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'packages/kbn-rule-type-params/**'

jobs:
  comment-on-changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Check for rule type param changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          # Get changed files in rule type params directory
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD -- packages/kbn-rule-type-params/)
          
          if [ -n "$CHANGED_FILES" ]; then
            echo "changed_files=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "files=$CHANGED_FILES" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "changed_files=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Comment on PR if rule type param changes
        if: env.changed_files == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: comments } = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number
            });

            // Check if we already commented about this
            const existingComment = comments.find(comment => 
              comment.body.includes('rule type param changes detected')
            );

            if (!existingComment) {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: context.issue.number,
                body: `## Rule Type Param Changes Detected 📝

This pull request includes changes to rule type parameters. Please ensure these changes are reviewed by the security team.

@kibana/contextual-security members, please review these changes as they may affect security rule configurations.

Files modified:
${process.env.files}
`
              });
            }
```
